definitions.explanation: a method of paying for something by dividing the total amount into multiple smaller payments over time

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{分割払|ぶんかつばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought this TV on installment payments.

examples.japanese: {分割払|ぶんかつばら}いだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: If you pay in installments, there's a handling fee.

examples.japanese: 3⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧{分割払|ぶんかつばら}いなら⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧です。
examples.english: If it's three installments, there's no handling fee.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧ (division) + ⟦{払|はら}い→払い：18738_harai⟧ (payment) → divided payment

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{一括払|いっかつばら}い→一括払い：17608_ikkatsubarai⟧ (lump-sum payment, one-time payment)

COMMON VARIATIONS:
- 3⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧ (3 installments)
- 6⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧ (6 installments)
- 12⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧ (12 installments)

CREDIT CARDS IN JAPAN:
When paying by credit card in Japan, stores often ask "⟦{一括|いっかつ}→一括：08947_ikkatsu⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？" (One payment or installments?)
